dict.string: Zoggyfin connects to your Jellyfin server on the local network and finds nearby devices to watch and listen together.
Zoggyfin uses Bluetooth to find nearby people who watch or listen together with you, also with no Wi-Fi.
Zoggyfin needs Location access only to join the Wi-Fi of a nearby Android phone. macOS gives Wi-Fi names only to apps with this permission.
